id.description: A unique identifier for the plugin, formatted as a UUID.

description.description: A brief description of the plugin's functionality.

author.description: The name of the author or organization that created the plugin.

version.description: The version of the plugin, following semantic versioning (e.g., '1.0.0').

entry.description: The entry point lua file for the plugin, which is executed when the plugin is loaded.

items.description: A list of capabilities that the plugin provides, such as 'mod-management', 'save-management', etc.

capabilities.description: An array of capabilities that the plugin supports.

items.description: A list of functionalities that the plugin implements, such as 'load-mods', 'save-game', etc.

functionality.description: An array of functionalities that the plugin implements.

settings.description: A set of settings for the plugin, which can be configured by the user.

default.description: The default value for the setting.
